n: Event <Hortus de Escapismo - Retrospection> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 10 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 25 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 40 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: One of the lounge's chairs, with an accompanying desk as a set. It's much heavier than it looks. Don't try to move alone! If you strain your back, all you can do is pray for the communion to be over soon so that someone can come and help!

A rug with Ambrosii's distinctive floral patterns. The residents weaved its patterns as they sat together and chatted. Hyman secretly learned some of the patterns only to make a few nice, new outfits for her kids.

A candle stand that doesn't look very stable at all. Be careful. Don't knock it over. Once the 'tea party' is over, silence falls upon the lounge once again. With the candle blown out, the residents bid farewell to tonight's gathering.
A bench that can be found just about anywhere. The Sankta like to maintain their guns and share sweets here. The back of the bench used to read 'Sankta only,' but that has since been scraped away.
A bench that can be found just about anywhere. Just the right size for a Sarkaz to lie down to take a nap. The back of the bench used to read 'Sarkaz only,' but that has since been scraped away.

A normal chandelier in Sanctilaminium Ambrosii. Its wing-like frame elevates a holy light. Raimund took down the candles and his eyes collided with Fortuna's. He is struck by his chair height. How else could he explain his sudden agitation?
A desk filled with Lateran scriptures. Turn the pages. Their teachings await your interpretation. Hear my prayers, grant me knowledge, and witness my deeds.—The Saints' Travels
A panoramic display showing the beauty of the monastery courtyard. Even when far from the real courtyard, the memories of Ambrosii have already taken root within our hearts.

Floor tiles laid according to the monastery's design. Not aligned all that well. The weeds in the gaps between the bricks are just like those of the monastery. No one knows who planted their seeds here.
'I will be the first meteor to fall from the lands to the skies.'
theme: Abbey room recreated from the description of Executor Richele. Residents sometimes come here to share blessings and a quiet time together.

list:
You've personally witnessed the Sanctilaminium Ambrosii beginning its new journey.
Some chose to leave, while those who remain will rebuild this paradise.
During the Hortus de Escapismo event, obtain Operator Insider.

You welcomed a new coworker.
Though an expert in protecting himself in the workplace, he's actually quite the professional.
During the Hortus de Escapismo event, spend 2,400 Statue Fragments in [Convivia Cenarum Localia].

The devout are thankful for your assistance.
You overhear someone wishing for your wellbeing as the residents pray before the statue.
Complete all stages in [Sanctilaminium Ambrosii] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You listened to the last piece of music performed by a certain someone.
Some have found peace, while others continue their search tirelessly.
Complete all the content in [Secretae Continere] and collect the rewards.

His Holiness has personally granted you a commendation for your service to the Curia.
You may choose any codename you like from the following: 'Mission Accomplisher,' 'Duty Harvester,' and 'Diligent Screwdriver.'
During the event, repair Makeshift Walkways 50 times with Spare Timber.

You have personally repaired all of the monastery's damage.
Time has taken away its former glory, leaving naught but disarray. Even then, there are yet those who diligently maintain their home.
Clear HE-8 with a 3-star rating while repairing all Makeshift Walkways on the battlefield.

Thanks to your hard work, there are no more holes in the floor.
With all this repair work done, will everything be restored back to how it used to be?
Complete all stages in [Sacrarium Derelictum] on Challenge Mode.

You've quelled all the disputes within the monastery.
Everyone yearns for peace, friendship, and hope, but where should you begin the search?
Clear HE-EX-3 with a 3-star rating with no Holy Statues destroyed.

Even in an intense battle, you did not forget to defend the faith.
Whether you are a believer or not, these statues have indeed served as encouragement and support to many.
Clear HE-EX-7 with a 3-star rating with Makeshift Walkways destroyed no more than 2 times.

You have mastered how to soothe anxious minds.
You know why they are anxious. You have the answer to where they can find tranquility.
set: Hortus de Escapismo Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set that serves as a reminder of the events that led to the Sanctilaminium Ambrosii's new journey.
Executor picks up the sole remaining flower, as the final piece resounds loudly within the Sacrarium.
A flight of fantasy and a mutual agreement. When the sun rises at dawn, the two set out on their separate journeys.
